page_title: INT 1-0 LEC | Inter v Lecce 14/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Fabio Maresca is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
90+3' Luis Henrique (Inter) picks up a yellow card.

90+3' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Fabio Maresca with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Petar Sucic (Inter) replacing Marcus Thuram.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Youssef Maleh is replaced by Alex Sala (Lecce).
86' A more precise finish was all that was needed for this set play to have been a success. Youssef Maleh (Lecce) received the ball far out and fired a projectile which went yards over the bar.
82' Substitution. Santiago Pierotti will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
80' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
78' 1 - 0 Goal! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
78' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Wladimiro Falcone, who makes a comfortable save.
77' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

77' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom left corner of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.
77' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
75' Manuel Akanji (Inter) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
75' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Jamil Siebert (Lecce) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Inter get a free kick.
73' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Yann Sommer.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Henrikh Mkhitaryan walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lautaro Martinez (Inter).
72' Carlos Augusto (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
71' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
70' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
69' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Omri Gandelman and he is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
69' Riccardo Sottil goes off the pitch and Tete Morente (Lecce) comes on.
66' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Carlos Augusto (Inter). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
65' Carlos Augusto (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Now Inter have a corner.
64' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
63' What was Danilo Veiga (Lecce) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
62' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
61' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
61' Inter have a free kick from a promising distance.
57' A substitution has been made. Andy Diouf goes off and Luis Henrique (Inter) comes on.
57' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny will be replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolo Barella can be given a rest.
55' Carlos Augusto (Inter) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
51' Andy Diouf (Inter) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.

51' Nicolo Barella (Inter) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Wladimiro Falcone, who pulls off a stunning save!
49' A cross into the box from Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is cleared.
48' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' The whistle blows and Fabio Maresca starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
45+3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nicolo Barella (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' The resulting corner from Nicolo Barella (Inter) is cleared by the defence.
45' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' The game is interrupted as Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is flagged offside.
43' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter).

36' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
35' The corner from Nicolo Barella (Inter) is cleared away by the defence.

35' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Marcus Thuram (Inter). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
29' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
28' NO PENALTY! Referee Fabio Maresca has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Inter players are incensed.
24' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Inter as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

24' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Inter after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
22' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
21' Nicolo Barella (Inter) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
19' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
19' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
15' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Piotr Zielinski (Inter), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
13' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
10' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
10' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
9' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
7' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
6' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Wladimiro Falcone.
4' Marcus Thuram (Inter) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Lecce have a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca is introduced as the referee for today's match.
